subject: Request: Exec pricing override for Helix BioAnalytics (Hosted API)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Cole <sara.cole@helixbio.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing proposal and next steps

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Attached is the initial pricing we've put together for the pilot (HLX_Initial_Pricing_v1.pdf). At the usage levels you shared (~1.5B tokens / month), our standard commercial offer for Hosted API is a 12% list discount plus a strategic volume tier that gets you to ~18% effective off list for a 6-month pilot.

I know you mentioned a competing offer that pushes deeper; if Helix is able to commit to a longer minimum term (9–12 months) and a firm monthly minimum, we can explore additional concessions. For transparency, anything >20% needs exec signoff given revenue impact and capacity reservation.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm desired pilot length and firm monthly token minimum
- I’ll model the commit economics and loop in revenue for approval if Helix asks for >20%
- If you’re ready, send the procurement sheet and I’ll attach a mutual action plan

Attachments: HLX_Initial_Pricing_v1.pdf

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sara Cole <sara.cole@helixbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot Morris <elliot.morris@helixbio.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing proposal and next steps

Ben —

Thanks for the proposal and for walking through the numbers. Happy to share the RFP summary (attached). To be competitive with the incumbent vendor and meet our CFO's cost targets for the pilot, we need a 25% discount on Hosted API list for the first 12 months.

Helix is prepared to commit to a 12-month pilot with a minimum spend of $100k/month and provide a short-term exclusivity window for the service areas we discussed. If Redwood can get to 25% and put a short-term capacity reservation in place, we can move to a signed SOW within two weeks.

Can you escalate for exec approval? We appreciate any flexibility — this is a strategic migration for us and there’s potential to expand to other teams if the pilot succeeds.

Attachments: Helix_RFP_Summary.pdf

Sara Cole
Head of Procurement | Helix BioAnalytics
sara.cole@helixbio.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Helix asks for 25% on Hosted API — need exec waiver / rationale

Vivek / Karthik —

Forwarding Helix's ask. Quick context:
- Account: Helix BioAnalytics (large mid-market bioscience software co)
- Request: 25% off Hosted API list for first 12 months on a $100k/month guaranteed pilot (they say)
- Why strategic: cross-sell to R&D and clinical analytics teams; strong reference potential in biopharma vertical; timeline: want SOW signed in 2 weeks

My recommendation: Approve a one-time 25% effective off-list for a 12-month firm commit with the following guardrails:
1) $100k/mo minimum for months 1–12 (recoverability clause if they miss threshold)
2) Capacity reservation fee (small fixed monthly fee) to protect throughput SLOs
3) Quarterly business reviews and success metrics tied to expansion credits

Projected P&L: incremental ARR upside if we convert them post-pilot; loss on unit economics is significant at 25% but offset by strategic value and potential expansion. I attached my commit model (helix_commit_model.xlsx).

Can you advise if Revenue signs off or if we need Mina's / CFO signoff? Happy to join an exec readout.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Helix: request for 25% hosted price concession — recommendation and ask for decision

Mina / Jonas —

Looping you in on Helix. Ben has walked through the numbers; they are asking for a 25% discount which is outside standard delegated authority. My read:
- Upside: potential enterprise expansion into 3 additional product teams, reference customer in biopharma pipeline space, likely $1M+ ARR opportunity if expanded after pilot
- Downside: At 25% we materially compress unit margin on tokens; requires capacity reservation to avoid noisy neighbors and protect SLOs

Proposed approval terms (recommendation):
- Approve 25% off list for Hosted API for a 12-month pilot with a $100k/month minimum (months 1–12)
- Add a $5k/month capacity reservation fee to offset fixed infra cost and prioritize servicing
- Include a clause: if monthly usage < 75% of committed minimum for two consecutive months, discount steps back to 18% until usage recovers
- Legal to draft a short amendment and DocuSign SOW; Finance to confirm revenue recognition and any deferral impact

Asks: Mina — can you approve this concession under revenue policy? Jonas — please confirm any finance flags (rev rec, reserves). Karthik — please confirm we can operationalize reservation and set SLOs.

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helix: request for 25% hosted price concession — APPROVED (conditions)

Vivek / team —

Approved. I authorize a one-time 25% effective discount off Hosted API list for Helix BioAnalytics under the following mandatory conditions:

1) Contractual: 12-month minimum term with a binding minimum spend of $100,000 per month for months 1–12.
2) Operational: $5,000/month capacity reservation fee (billing line item) to be added to SOW.
3) Performance guardrail: If usage drops below 75% of the committed minimum for two consecutive months, discount should revert to 18% until they meet threshold for two consecutive months.
4) Legal / Finance: Legal to prepare amendment and attach approved_rate_card_helix.pdf; Finance (Jonas) — confirm revenue recognition approach and any reserve to cover expected margin impact.
5) Success criteria: Quarterly business review cadence and clear expansion KPI tied to credits (if they hit expansion threshold in Q4 we will provision additional commercial incentives).

Please proceed to convert the existing SOW to an amendment and get it DocuSigned. Ben — work with the Helix procurement team to finalize timelines. This transaction is approved by Revenue — notify Deal Desk to mark concession as executed (deal_id: HLX-2026-09-02-01).

Mina Haddad
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

[Attachments referenced above are stubs and not included inline: HLX_Initial_Pricing_v1.pdf (pdf), Helix_RFP_Summary.pdf (pdf), helix_commit_model.xlsx (spreadsheet), approved_rate_card_helix.pdf (pdf)]
